findings.title: Signal has significant reference plane gap
findings.description: Net AFE_MOSI has 68% reference plane coverage over 28.5mm of routing. Return current must detour around the gap, creating a loop antenna.
findings.recommendation: Route this signal to avoid ground plane gaps, or fill the void. If a split is intentional, add a bridge capacitor across the gap.

findings.title: Low ground plane fill ratio
findings.description: Ground zone on F.Cu has 58% fill ratio. Excessive routing or thermal relief patterns may be reducing ground plane effectiveness.
findings.recommendation: Reduce routing density on this layer or move signals to other layers.
findings.summary: Low ground plane fill ratio

findings.title: Insufficient ground pins on J1
findings.description: J1 (ELECTRODES) has 0 ground pin(s) for 10 signal pins. Recommended: at least 3 ground pins for adequate return current path and cable shielding.
findings.recommendation: Ensure J1 has sufficient ground pins. For high-speed interfaces, ground pins should be distributed among signal pins, not grouped at one end.
findings.summary: Insufficient ground pins on J1

findings.title: Clock MCU_SCK on outer layer
findings.description: Clock net MCU_SCK is 100% routed on outer layers (microstrip). Inner stripline layers provide better shielding from radiation.
findings.recommendation: Route clock signals on inner layers (stripline) when possible.
findings.summary: Clock MCU_SCK on outer layer

findings.title: Clock AFE_CLK on outer layer
findings.description: Clock net AFE_CLK is 100% routed on outer layers (microstrip). Inner stripline layers provide better shielding from radiation.
findings.recommendation: Route clock signals on inner layers (stripline) when possible.
findings.summary: Clock AFE_CLK on outer layer

findings.title: Clock SWDCLK on outer layer
findings.description: Clock net SWDCLK is 62% routed on outer layers (microstrip). Inner stripline layers provide better shielding from radiation.
findings.recommendation: Route clock signals on inner layers (stripline) when possible.
findings.summary: Clock SWDCLK on outer layer

findings.title: Adjacent signal layers: In2.Cu, B.Cu
findings.description: Signal layers In2.Cu and B.Cu are adjacent without a reference plane between them. This causes high crosstalk and poor return path control for signals on both layers.
findings.recommendation: Reorder stackup to place a ground or power plane between every pair of signal layers.
findings.summary: Adjacent signal layers: In2.Cu, B.Cu

findings.title: Signal layer In2.Cu far from reference plane
findings.description: Signal layer In2.Cu is 0.65mm from nearest reference plane (In1.Cu). Tight coupling (0.1-0.2mm) reduces loop area and improves EMC.
findings.recommendation: Consider stackup adjustment to reduce signal-to-reference spacing.
findings.summary: Signal layer In2.Cu far from reference plane

findings.title: Signal layer B.Cu far from reference plane
findings.description: Signal layer B.Cu is 0.76mm from nearest reference plane (In1.Cu). Tight coupling (0.1-0.2mm) reduces loop area and improves EMC.
findings.recommendation: Consider stackup adjustment to reduce signal-to-reference spacing.
findings.summary: Signal layer B.Cu far from reference plane

findings.title: Board cavity resonance frequencies
findings.description: Board (45×45mm, εr=4.3) cavity resonances: (0,1) at 1606 MHz; (1,0) at 1606 MHz; (1,1) at 2272 MHz. PDN impedance spikes at these frequencies. Ensure adequate decoupling at and around these frequencies.
findings.recommendation: Add decoupling capacitors with SRF near these frequencies.
findings.summary: Board cavity resonance frequencies

findings.title: Missing stitching via at layer transition: AFE_CS
findings.description: Net AFE_CS has 4 layer transition(s) across B.Cu, F.Cu, In2.Cu. 1 transition(s) have no ground stitching via within 1.0mm. The return current must find an alternate path, creating a loop antenna.
findings.recommendation: Add a ground stitching via within 1.0mm of each signal via. Place the ground via adjacent to the signal via on the same pad cluster.
findings.summary: Missing stitching via at layer transition: AFE_CS
